Name: Jabez
Summary: More honourable than his brethren, who prayed that God would bless him and keep him from evil, and God granted his request.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 4:9; 1 Chronicles 4:10: More honourable than his brethren, who prayed that God would bless him and keep him from evil, and God granted his request.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jabez in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
